summary: Cron embedding job that never records progress, a harvest that re-inserts the feed every run, and an auth fallback that lists every legacy KV key.

expected_findings.contains: UPDATE articles SET embedded_at = ? WHERE source_id = ?
expected_findings.explanation: embedPending() selects the 50 oldest rows with embedded_at IS NULL, embeds them with Workers AI, upserts them to Vectorize and inserts embeddings rows, then marks them done with WHERE source_id = ? bound to the integer id. Nothing matches, so the same 50 rows are embedded again every 5 minutes forever with no user activity.

expected_findings.contains: "INSERT INTO articles (source_id, title, body, fetched_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)"
expected_findings.explanation: harvest() inserts every item of the latest-100 feed on every 5-minute run with a plain INSERT; source_id has only a non-unique index, so overlapping items are stored again each run. articles grows without retention, and every duplicate becomes embedding work once progress is recorded.

expected_findings.contains: await env.KEYS.list<{ secret: string; name: string }>({ prefix: "legacy:", cursor })
expected_findings.explanation: With LEGACY_KEY_SCAN on, every request with an unknown token lists the whole legacy: prefix before returning 401, one list operation per 1,000 keys, with no rate limit in front. The SEARCH_LIMITER binding is configured but never called.
